text_block_list.text:
Summer. To the Умамусумэs, it is the season of summer camp, 
to train their bodies and minds for autumn…… but also to 
relax and nourish their spirits.

The "Summer Walk" is designed for these Умамусумэs. 
A set of refreshing events under the summer skies.

The academy provides full support with tours 
and travel expenses. And so, this year's fun 
midsummer journey begins…

text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл
text_block_list.text: FOOOOOOOO!!!! Let's Barbecue Parteey!

text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл
text_block_list.text:
Where the drinks at? And desserts? Are the carrots 
ready? And of course we need burgers～♪

text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл
text_block_list.text: Ooh, I need to take a photograph too! Heyhey, Dober! Say cheese!

text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер
text_block_list.text: Ahaha…… Taiki please, you're too excited.

text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер
text_block_list.text: (……But, yeah, looks like she's having fun. I'm glad we came.)

text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл
text_block_list.text: Sniffle… Sniff…… I haven't been back home for so long, I miss you two… Papa… mama…… Sabishii dess……

text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер
text_block_list.text: (………… Okay, today is the day I'll ask her……!)

text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to go camping with me for this year's 
Summer Walk? Maybe if we made some fun memories 
together, you would feel a little less lonely—

text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер
text_block_list.text:
(…… But still… can I even fill the gap of her precious family? 
Aaa, I'm losing confidence again ……!)

text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл
text_block_list.text: Dober! Whatchu doing out here― Wao, is that a campground brochure!?

text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл
text_block_list.text: Maybe… it's about the Summer Walk!? Uoh, I want to go! I want to go with you～～!!

text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер
text_block_list.text: Oh, of…… of course!

text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер
text_block_list.text:
(Well, she invited me instead but…… oh well. I'm going to 
make sure Taiki has a good time for the next five days…!)

text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер
text_block_list.text: Mmmm, char-grilled really turns out different doesn't it?! Steamy carrotsies are so very delicious!

text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
text_block_list.text:
Mambo! 
Mind your playing around!

text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер
text_block_list.text:
A-ha-ha-ha! Whoo, that gave me a shock! 
Never thought I'd bump into you all here!

text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер
text_block_list.text:
Same here…… but I shouldn't be surprised when 
the tour is backed by the academy.

text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер
text_block_list.text: Speaking of which, where are your usual friends?

text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер
text_block_list.text:
Hold on to your hats now… I'm making my solo-camp debut! 
So I'm all by my lonesomes! What about you, El?

text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
text_block_list.text:
I'm, you know… 
I was actually going to come with Grass, but our 
schedules didn't work out, so—

text_block_list.name: Mambo
text_block_list.text: Guaah!

text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
text_block_list.text:
I had no choice but to come with Mambo, two birds of a feather. 
After all, a condor can't well stretch its wings at the academy—

text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
text_block_list.text:
¡Uy! N-no, this condor isn't mine! 
I've never seen it in my life!

text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер
text_block_list.text: Mmm?…… For realsies?

text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер
text_block_list.text:
(…… I see. I guess she want to let 
her secret pet play in wide open space.)

text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер
text_block_list.text:
(As a senior, I should probably tap her for it, but… 
I guess I can let it go for the Summer Walk.)

text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер
text_block_list.text:
…… Hey uhh anyway, you know… 
… If you don't mind, we…… umm—

text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл
text_block_list.text: Wow! El & Tannhauser! Great to see you two here! Let's have ourselves a blast～!

text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер
text_block_list.text:
Say what? Yeey, you mean it?! 
…… I was actually starting to feel too solo on this camping～.

text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
text_block_list.text: Tha, tha, thank God!
And with that said―!

text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
text_block_list.text:
Sweeeeee! It took it, it took it! 
El's got herself a bite!!

text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер
text_block_list.text:
That's amazing! 
Let's see…… El, bring it in calmly. Careful, careful……!

text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл
text_block_list.text:
There's a bike rental over there! 
Let's go, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Матиканэтангейзер
text_block_list.text:
Let's go, let's gooo♪ 
— Wait I have to bring my wallet!

text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл
text_block_list.text:
Wooooo!! What a huge open plain……! 
Dober, let's do the thing! Flop!

text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер
text_block_list.text: Ahahah, sheesh. Oh whatever.

text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл
text_block_list.text: …… Feheh♪ So many happy photos just from today!

text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер
text_block_list.text:
You're in high spirits. 
Will your battery last the 4 nights and 5 days at this rate?

text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл
text_block_list.text:
No problem! 
I brought oodles of batteries! No oversights here!

text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер
text_block_list.text:
…… Speaking of which, why do you like photography, Taiki? 
I see you take a lot of pictures in the dorms too.

text_block_list.name: Тайки Шаттл
text_block_list.text:
Why? Nnn…… I like going through them again. So even 
when I'm alone, I have all kinds of Воспоминания с me!

text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер
text_block_list.text: (…… I see. Taiki gets lonely easier than most……)

text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро Добер
text_block_list.text:
…… We'll make lots of fun memories! 
I'll, you know… try my best too!

text_block_list.name: Зенно Роб Рой
text_block_list.text:
…… This must be "Gille Dubh's Garden". And the river 
over there…… no mistaking it. As I thought, this place is―!
